question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Forbore
solution:
The correct answer is **option (1)** i.e. **'Refrain'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Forbore : (****संयम बरता****) **- means the act of refraining or abstaining from something.

 
 
• **Example:** Even though he was tempted, he **forbore **from eating the last piece of cake. (Present form is **forbear**)
 
 
 
• **Refrain : (परहेज़)** - means to stop oneself from doing something.
 
 
• **Example: **Despite the insult, she **refrained** from responding in kind.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is 'Refrain'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Submit : (प्रस्तुत) **- Accept or yield to a superior force or to the authority or will of another person. 

 
 
• **Example: **You must submit your application before the deadline to be considered.
 
 
 
• **Yield : (उत्पादन) - **To produce or provide (profit, results, crop, etc.), or to give way to arguments, demands, or pressure.
 
 
• **Example:** The apple trees yielded a good crop this year.
 
 
 
• **Surrender : (समर्पण) -** Cease resistance to an enemy or opponent and submit to their authority.
 
 
• **Example: ** The army had no choice but to surrender after days of being outnumbered and outgunned. 
 
 

32:Tb85,

The correct answer is option (3)<
